note: Simulated security advisories for the demo hall (CLAUDE.md: simulated data only). IDs are fictional. Production reads a vendor/NVD/CISA KEV feed instead; title and summary are untrusted text.

advisories.title: Monitoring agent: unauthenticated remote code execution in the metrics endpoint
advisories.summary: Versions before 4.2.1 accept crafted scrape requests that run code as root. Exploitation reported in the wild. The 4.2.1 live patch needs no reboot.

advisories.title: GPU kernel driver: local privilege escalation through an ioctl
advisories.summary: A local user can escalate to kernel privileges on driver branches before 550.90.07. The fixed driver needs BMC firmware 3.2.0 or newer. Installing it reboots the node.

advisories.title: Leaf switch OS: malformed BGP update resets sessions
advisories.summary: A malformed BGP update can reset every session on the switch. Fixed in 10.6.0; the upgrade reboots the switch.
